Nature.title: Restoring hearing in people with a rare form of deafness
Nature.summary: How a decades-long quest led to the first gene therapy for deafness caused by a mutation.

Nature.title: Global mangrove distribution on the open coast is controlled by waves
Nature.summary: A process-driven mangrove presence or absence model using 20 years of open-source wave data shows that wave conditions are critical in determining where mangroves grow worldwide.

Nature.title: X-ray liquidography decodes complex motions in azobenzene isomerization
Nature.summary: Time-resolved X-ray liquidography films the structural changes of azobenzene during trans-to-cis isomerization in solution with atomic-level precision.

Nature.title: Histone readers MLLT1 and MLLT3 concentrate AID to confer locus specificity
Nature.summary: By being restricted to target regions by MLLT1–MLLT3 occupancy, activation-induced deaminase activity is able to avoid most off-target mutagenesis during B cell somatic hypermutation.

Nature.title: Carbene transfer from thianthrenium ylides for cyclopropanation
Nature.summary: Thianthrenium ylides can be used as a general platform for metal–carbene generation and transfer, including cyclopropanation, σ-bond insertion and sigmatropic rearrangements.

Nature.title: An amygdala to anterior hypothalamic circuit gates stress sensitivity
Nature.summary: The anterior hypothalamic nucleus regulates negative valence in the brain, highlighting a new pathway that controls sensitivity to stressful events and signposting approaches to identify new circuit interactions relevant to mental health.

Nature.title: Dynamic protrusions mediate crawling motility in Asgard archaea
Nature.summary: Anoxic live-cell imaging shows actin-dependent crawling motility and dynamic protrusions in Asgard archaea, providing insights into cellular innovations that may have contributed to eukaryotic evolution.

Nature.title: Wafer-scale epitaxy growth of high-mobility p-type boron carbon nitride
Nature.summary: A dual-precursor chemical system is used to achieve wafer-scale epitaxy growth of boron carbon nitride, a high-performance p-type semiconductor, for potential integration in efficient 2D materials for electronics.

Nature.title: Written in development and lost in ageing: the grammar of cellular identity
Nature.summary: Ageing reflects progressive decanalization of mammalian cell identity, driven by erosion of a regulatory grammar written during development.
